findings.claim: The grant add --classes usage text still lists only the five old classes; budget, lane-recovery and run-release are grantable but not named in the help.
findings.evidence: cmd/metasystem/intent_planning.go:279 usage "with everything: only these classes of act: mechanical, recovery, ordering, acks, stale-releases"; goal.AttorneyClasses now holds eight. The unknown-class diagnostic does list all eight.
findings.change: Name the grantable list in the usage (best done in U1a3, which rewrites that list). Optional.
findings.relation: new; rule: a verb's help names every value it accepts

findings.claim: A delegated admission's attorney log line has act= twice: the quoted verb, then the class.
findings.evidence: attorney_admits.go builds the line with act=%q (the verb) and then appends " decision="+D+" act="+C, as brief A6 prescribes. The only reader (internal/steward/situation.go:493-497) keeps raw lines, so nothing breaks today.
findings.change: None needed now. A later key=value reader has to handle the repeated key. Optional.
findings.relation: new; rule: a log line names each key once

findings.claim: The decision is checked only for shape, and every descendant of a decision child inherits METASYSTEM_DECISION.
findings.evidence: admit accepts any non-empty token without whitespace (A6, V1); intent_delivery.go:418-419 appends to os.Environ. This is inert in U1a2: the only mapped delegated act, work stop run:, is refused at intent_work.go:3060-3064.
findings.change: None in this unit. U1b1c and U1b2a should note it when a decision child can start long-lived processes. Optional.
findings.relation: new; rule: a delegated admission is bound to its decision

findings.claim: A hard-limit refusal of a delegated act is logged without its decision id.
findings.evidence: humanauthority.RecordAttorneyRefusal writes grant, by, act and reason from proof.Helm but not Helm.Decision or Helm.Act.
findings.change: Consider adding decision= to the refusal line in the overrule and reporting units (U3a1 and later). Optional.
findings.relation: new; rule: every attorney log line of a delegated act names its decision
